data: Are there two types of relationships linking the concepts in the ReVerb translation memory?

The figure shows two types of relationships linking the concepts in the ReVerb translation memory. The first type is indicated by the "appears-in-case" relationship, which connects the chunks within each case to the corresponding WORDs. The second type is indicated by the "super" relationship, which connects the chunks within each case to the super concept. Therefore, the answer is yes, there are two types of relationships linking the concepts in the ReVerb translation memory.
